description: Upload a resume from a file on the user's local machine. Provide the absolute file path to a PDF, DOC, or DOCX file. Maximum file size: 5MB. By default, your profile will be synced with the resume content.

filePath.description: Absolute path to the resume file on the local machine (e.g. "/Users/john/Documents/resume.pdf")

isAltResume.description: Upload as an alternate resume instead of replacing the primary resume (default: false)

syncProfile.description: Whether to sync profile with resume content (default: true). Ignored for alt resumes.

name: upload_resume_from_file
